name: How to Remove a Prime Ice Construct

value.text: How to Remove a Prime Ice Construct

imgDesc.text:
Tap on "Fab-Vision" to enter the Build Prime Ice mode. When a preview blueprint overlaps existing Prime Ice or a Prime Ice Construct, the affected item will be marked red. At this time, pressing Build will remove the corresponding Prime Ice Constructs and Prime Ice.
Removing Prime Ice refunds Prime Ice Resource, while removing Prime Ice constructs will only return the corresponding fabrication materials and not energy to the Eye of Graeae.
